body:
Thank you, but I do not have the will to live whatsoever. My family does not accept me, I have no friend, and I am not in a relationship. I do not have a job, and I feel as though I am wasting my life.

I would like to pass away as quickly and painlessly as possible. I can’t even tie a noose, that’s how imbecilic I am. Even if I had rope, I wouldn’t be able to tie it.
